sources.title: Qwen3-32B model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint card reports 32.8B total and 31.2B non-embedding parameters, text generation, thinking/non-thinking modes, tool calling and local deployment. Native context is 32,768; YaRN is validated to 131,072 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 launch announcement explicitly includes Qwen3-32B among six dense, open-weight models under Apache 2.0; situates Qwen3 within the Qwen family.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3ForCausalLM configuration has 64 layers, 64 query heads and eight KV heads, model_type qwen3, no expert routing, max_position_embeddings 40960 and rope_scaling null.

sources.title: Official Qwen3 repository
sources.evidence: Identifies the developer as Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud; release news explicitly dates the Qwen3 series release 2025.04.29.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B license
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository contains the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3-32B commit history
sources.evidence: Shows the checkpoint upload on April 28, 2025, before the April 29 announcement. Upload history does not establish when the repository became public.

name.note: Display normalization of the official Qwen3-32B name.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud.

family.note: Qwen3 is explicitly part of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Explicit developer release date. April 28 is an upload date; the baseline's public-release date is not independently established.

open_weights.note: Public checkpoint and explicit open-weight release announcement.

license.note: Checkpoint license and release announcement agree.

parameters_b.note: Developer-rounded total in billions; 32B is branding.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active count for this dense checkpoint; 31.2B excludes embeddings and is not an active count.

architecture.note: Explicitly dense; causal Transformer with grouped-query attention.

context_window.note: Maximum with YaRN, not native context. The shipped configuration sets 40,960 positions without scaling.

modalities.note: Text causal language model and text-chat examples; no multimodal components.

description.value: Dense open Qwen model for self-hosted chat, reasoning, and coding
description.note: Supported by the deployment examples and documented capabilities.

patch.notes: Developer-rounded total is 32.8B; active parameters are not separately reported. Context is 32,768 natively and 131,072 with YaRN; shipped config allows 40,960 positions without scaling. Release uses the explicit April 29 announcement; April 28 checkpoint uploads do not establish public availability.

summary: Correct total parameters from 32B branding to 32.8B, fill dense architecture and Apache-2.0 license, and use the explicit April 29 release announcement. Confirm text-only, thinking and tool support. Retain 131,072 maximum with a YaRN qualification; active count remains undisclosed.
